title: Introduce decision-proof log and KMS fidelity gate
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds a decision proof log for RBAC v2 policy evaluations and a KMS fidelity gate that records and optionally replays KMS call metadata for compliance audits. No customer-facing API changes.
body:
Summary: Add a standalone Decision Proof Log (DPL) that records policy decisions (RBAC v2) with cryptographic provenance, and introduce a KMS Fidelity Gate that captures KMS call metadata (provider, region, key-id fingerprint, request-hash) for each decision that depended on KMS-backed keys. This PR wires the DPL into the auth pipeline, provides a compact audit-forwarding path, and adds a safe opt-in replay mode for incident investigation.

Motivation: Customers in regulated industries asked for tamper-evident decision records and an unambiguous link between resource access decisions and the KMS context used to satisfy them (ENG-1427, SEC-89).

Design goals:
1) Non-blocking: DPL writes are async with backpressure safeguards; 2) Tamper-evident: proof chain uses keyed HMAC with rotated audit keys; 3) Minimal latency impact on hot path; 4) Optional replay/export for compliance teams.

Changes included (high-level):
- New service: auth/decisionprover (go) — records decision entries, computes HMAC proofs, stores to durable audit-topic.
- KMS adapter: services/kms/fidelity_gate.go — captures KMS metadata and attaches fidelity assertions to decision payloads.
- Auth pipeline: middleware/authz/decision_logger.go — invokes DPL on allow/deny results and attaches trace ids.
- Telemetry: observability/metrics/decision_proofing.prom — counters and latency histograms.
- Infra: infra/helm/templates/audit-config.yaml — feature flags and retention defaults; infra/terraform/audit_topic.tf updates to add new pubsub topic.
- Docs: docs/security/decision-proofing.md — implementation notes and operational runbook.
- Tests: integration/authz_dpl_e2e_test.go and unit tests covering signature rotation and backpressure.

Commits:
- a2f9d3c: initial DPL service scaffolding and protobufs
- b7c8e34: integrate DPL into authz middleware; add async writer
- c3fd021: implement KMS fidelity gate and attachers
- d9e1b55: metrics, feature-flag configuration, helm template changes
- f4127a1: add integration tests and e2e CI job
- 0bb3c6f: docs and runbook, Linear links, changelog entry

Files changed (representative):
- src/auth/middleware/decision_logger.go
- src/auth/decisionprover/service.go
- src/auth/decisionprover/writer.go
- services/kms/fidelity_gate.go
- infra/helm/templates/audit-config.yaml
- infra/terraform/audit_topic.tf
- docs/security/decision-proofing.md
- tests/integration/authz_dpl_e2e_test.go
- observability/metrics/decision_proofing.prom
- Makefile (ci job)

Implementation notes:
- Decision entries contain: request_id, principal, resource, action, policy_version, decision, timestamp, proof_hmac (base64), kms_fidelity_block (optional JSON blob with provider, key_fingerprint, region, api_version, request_hash).
- Proof HMAC uses an audit-key injected from secret manager and rotated by the audit-ops job; rotation produces an envelope version number.
- DPL writes are batched and retried; when the audit topic is unreachable the middleware records a local diagnostic event and continues (opt-out via feature flag disables this fallback).
- The KMS Fidelity Gate is pluggable: adapters for aws/kms and gcp/kms included. The gate does not proxy secrets; it only records normalized metadata and a short request-hash (HMAC of request payload) so that replay is possible without exfiltrating sensitive plaintext.

Security review summary:
- Threat modeling completed in SEC-89; main risk is accidental inclusion of sensitive ciphertext in logs — mitigations: strict schema validation, scrubber in writer, and redaction policy enforced in infra.
- KMS adapters specifically avoid recording plaintext or encryption contexts in full.

Testing and CI:
- New e2e job authz-dpl-e2e runs against a local test KMS shim and the audit-topic emulator.
- Unit tests for signature verification and key rotation added.
- CI checks: go fmt, go vet, unit tests (pass), integration e2e (flaky in first run, rerun passed), lint, security-scan (terrascan policy for infra changes) — overall CI status: pass.

Review conversation (selected):
- Ruth Chen (reviewer): "Can we ensure the HMAC key is never exported via snapshot logs? Add a unit test that simulates rotation and verifies old proofs remain verifiable."
- Aisha (author): "Added verify_rotation_test.go and ensured the audit-key is marked as non-exportable in the secret manifest. Also tightened logging so key material is never printed."
- Luca Moretti (reviewer): "This looks good. One concern: what happens if the audit-topic retention exceeds allowed bounds? Add limits and an alert."
- Aisha: "Added retention default to 90d and configured an infra alert to fire when topic backlog > 100k messages in infra/monitoring — see infra/terraform/alerts.tf (follow-up PR planned to centralize alerts)."
- Priya Shah (security): "Please confirm that the KMS adapters cannot be used to exfiltrate on-demand key metadata."
- Aisha: "Adapters only record deterministic fingerprints and request-hash; added explicit schema validation and test 'kms_adapter_no_exfil_test.go'."
- Ruth Chen: "Approve after CI green and docs review."

Approval and merge:
- PR approved by Ruth Chen and Priya Shah.
- Docs reviewed by Platform Docs (content/ownership tracked).
- Merged via squash on 2025-11-26 by Ruth Chen.

Rollout and ops notes:
- Feature is behind helm feature-flag 'decisionProof.enabled' (default: false for existing clusters).
- For Hosted customers we will enable in a staggered rollout after informing compliance contacts; Dedicated/Private customers can opt-in via config.
- Operator runbook added in docs/security/decision-proofing.md with steps for key rotation, emergency disable, and replay guidance.

Follow-ups / Known limitations:
- Currently the fidelity gate adapters do not include Azure KMS; follow-up ticket ENG-1583 scheduled.
- Replay mode requires access to the request payload hashes and mapping to stored request bodies; we added a sentinel design doc and will ship a controlled export flow.
- The audit-topic backlog alerting needs centralization (see ENG-1532).

Checklist:
- [x] Design and threat model (SEC-89)
- [x] Unit & integration tests
- [x] CI jobs added and passing
- [x] Documentation and runbook
- [x] Infra changes applied to helm/terraform
- [x] Security review approval (Priya Shah)

Merge outcome: merged, squash.

Notes for release: no breaking changes; enable behind flag.

Linear/Jira: ENG-1427 (implementation), SEC-89 (security review), SUP-4123 (customer request).
